articles.title: New Glenn Explosion Throws NASA's Lunar Ambitions into Uncertainty
articles.summary: A Blue Origin New Glenn rocket exploded during a test at Cape Canaveral, damaging its only launch pad. No one was injured, but the blast could delay NASA's Moon base plans and Amazon's satellite internet rollout. Repairs may take months.

articles.title: America's Cattle Herd Hits a 75-Year Low—What's Behind the Shrinking Supply?
articles.summary: The U.S. cattle inventory has dropped to 86.2 million head, the smallest since 1951. Rising costs, drought, an aging farmer workforce, and a resurgent parasite are squeezing ranchers. Beef production remains high, but retail prices are climbing.

articles.title: Wildfire Fallout and a Reality TV Challenger Shake Up LA Mayor's Race
articles.summary: Los Angeles Mayor Karen Bass faces a tough re-election bid amid criticism over her handling of the devastating Palisades Fire and homelessness. Her most colorful challenger is Spencer Pratt, a reality TV personality who lost his home in the blaze.
